_comment: Copy to ~/.ghosttype/config.json. All keys optional — omitted keys use the safe defaults. A value that fails its range is ignored (the default is kept), so a typo can never silently loosen a safety limit.

_ranges.maxTokensNight: positive number — hard nightly token ceiling
_ranges.maxCostUsd: positive number — hard nightly dollar ceiling (the overnight-bill kill-switch)
_ranges.nightDeadlineHour: integer 0-23 — local hour the night hard-stops
_ranges.maxConsecErrors: integer >= 1 — consecutive engine errors before the breaker trips
_ranges.humanIdleThreshold: number >= 5 — seconds of no input before haunt-drive may type (a lower value is rejected: 0 would let a failed idle probe look idle and type over a present human)
_ranges.maxCards: integer >= 1 — cards per arm when no single project is named
_ranges.backpressureThreshold: integer >= 1 — unmerged ghost/* branches before a project is paused
_ranges.minStable: integer >= 2 — consecutive stable polls before a pane counts as idle
_ranges.sandbox: boolean — macOS OS-sandbox for UNTRUSTED repos: confines the coding session's writes to the clone AND denies network in acceptance tests (breaks tests/work that need the network or write outside the clone)
